$comment: The component guard's config: agentic-cms check-components reads it, and pnpm lint runs it after ESLint. The layer keys (motion, ui, patterns, sections, registry, ignores) are the options of componentRules() in eslint.config.mjs, with the same defaults: keep the two alike. Loosening the guard — a layer dropped, a route exception or an inherited file added — is its own pull request, said so in its title.
$layers: No motion folder: agentic-cms/ix is the motion layer. No patterns yet. The sections live in the folder of the page they belong to.
$routes: The content engine's route folders: the app folder and the catch-all that renders content/pages/<slug>.yaml through the section registry. Every page is one of those files.
$exceptions: The routes outside the content engine, each with the reason it stays there; a bare one fails the guard. A *-demo folder (a design round's, the lab's) is one by name and needs no entry.

exceptions.src/app/blog-post/[slug]: the post pipeline: a post is content/blog/<slug>.md, rendered by the post template
exceptions.src/app/api/forms/[id]: the form endpoint, POST /api/forms/[id], the one route that runs at request time
exceptions.src/app/feed.xml: the RSS feed, written from the posts

$owners:
The files that own a part the lint keeps out of code, each with its reason: the engines' forms (a
, a server action, a fetch of another origin) and tags (next/script, a

forms.src/components/ui/form/Form.tsx: the form engine's renderer: the one <form>, posting each definition of src/config/forms.ts through its backend

images.src/components/ui/Media.tsx: the picture primitive: every a section shows, lazy, or eager through EagerImage above the fold

$allow: The preferred rules a file keeps its own choice of, each with the reason the review reads (an entry with no reason fails the guard). eslint.config.mjs reads this list.

allow.reason: the wireframe's crossed box: two lines stretched to any ratio, which no icon draws
the honeypot sits far off-screen, where a bot fills it and a reader never sees it: an offset no token names

$ignores: In the kit's own checkout src/lib is the package's source: init leaves these two lines out of a site, whose src/lib is its own and linted.
$inherited: Files the guard leaves alone, frozen: here the blog's post template, which the blog routes render themselves rather than the registry (the body with its stylesheet, its element overrides, the card and the hero). Nothing new is added; a file leaves the list when a registered section or a primitive replaces it.
